note: 미션 클리어 이미지 정의. tiers 순서 = 파일 번호(0 클리어, 1 전투, 2 도발, 3 고자극). groups에 묶음별 연출 지시와 분위기를 적는다. 미션의 scenes가 비어 있으면 beat(미션 요약) + 묶음의 단계 지시로 프롬프트를 만든다. 로맨틱은 4단계 대신 요원별 '그날 밤' 6컷(n_<요원>_<1..6>.jpg)으로 바뀌어 nights에 정의한다(현재는 ChatGPT 프롬프트 전용).
style: Semi-realistic anime illustration, cinematic lighting, rich detail, the same art style as the reference images. Vertical 2:3 composition. Every face fully visible and unobstructed, heads in the upper half of the frame with clear space above the hair. No text, no logo, no watermark.

missions.title: 혼자 남은 사람
missions.place: Harbor warehouse no. 3 at night, stacked shipping containers, sodium lamps, wet concrete, sea fog.
scenes: She walks out of the warehouse door at dawn, the freed hostage a blurred silhouette behind her, glancing back over her shoulder.
She takes down a masked guard from behind between the containers, red scarf whipping in the air.
She sits on a shipping crate by the pier, jacket unzipped low, pulling the red scarf down from her lips with a smirk, harbor lights behind.
A small safehouse room above the harbor at dawn. She leans on the window frame in black lace lingerie with the red scarf still around her neck, her gear dropped on the floor.

missions.title: 원거리 지원
missions.place: A mountain road checkpoint at night, pine forest, a watchtower and a radio mast, cold mist.
scenes: The two walk away side by side from the dead radio mast, the sniper carrying her rifle on her shoulder, the leader with a hand on her knife.
The sniper lies prone taking the shot at the watchtower while the leader crouches beside her calling the wind, muzzle flash and drifting mist.
Both lean against a parked off-road vehicle on the mountain road, jackets open, one fixing the other's collar, both looking at the viewer with teasing smiles.
A mountain cabin by a fireplace. Both in lace lingerie under one shared blanket, the rifle resting against the wall, warm firelight.

missions.title: 눈이 되는 자
missions.place: A corporate front office at night, glass walls, a cold blue server room, dead CCTV monitors.
scenes: Inside the elevator on the way out, the hacker holds up a data drive with a grin while the leader stands with arms crossed.
The hacker kills the cameras from a tablet as her drone hovers, the leader slipping through the server racks with a knife, screens going black one by one.
The dark executive office. The hacker sits on the CEO's desk with legs crossed and glasses pushed up, the leader leaning on the desk beside her, shirts loosened.
A high-floor hotel room, city neon through the window. Both in lingerie, the hacker with headphones still around her neck, the leader with her red scarf, laptops forgotten on the bed.

missions.title: 길을 내는 자
missions.place: An abandoned mine, timber-braced tunnels, an armory deep inside, dust in lamp light.
scenes: The two walk out of the mine mouth into morning light, dusted grey, the breacher with a sledge on her shoulder, the sniper slinging her rifle.
The breacher smashes through a cracked wall in a burst of rubble while the sniper covers the tunnel with her rifle, debris frozen mid-air.
Sitting on ammunition crates in the armory, tank tops and unzipped suits, wiping dust off each other, grinning at the viewer.
A mountain hot spring at night after the job. Both in swimsuits in rising steam, towels on the rocks, lantern light.

missions.title: 가면 무도회
missions.place: A patron's mansion during a masquerade ball, chandeliers, a grand staircase, a study with a hidden safe.
scenes: The two descend the grand staircase leaving the party, masks in hand, the ledger tucked under an arm, exchanging a look.
In the study, the infiltrator in an evening gown and mask opens the safe while the hacker crouches under the desk with a laptop, a guard's shadow at the door.
On the ballroom balcony, the infiltrator lifts her mask with a knowing smile, gown slit showing her leg, the hacker beside her in a loosened waiter vest.
The mansion's powder room, gilded mirrors and candlelight. Both in lace lingerie still wearing their masquerade masks, champagne glasses in hand.

missions.title: 마지막 한 명
missions.place: An isolation ward of a private hospital at night, long white corridors, red emergency lights.
scenes: The two support a wounded informant, seen from behind, down the corridor toward the exit, both looking forward, steady.
The medic fires a tranquilizer dart down the corridor as the leader covers her flank with a knife, red emergency light and falling guards.
An empty ward room after the fight. The medic sits on the bed edge with her coat open, the leader leans in the doorway with scarf loosened, both eyeing the viewer.
A safehouse at night. The medic in lingerie under an open white coat bandages the leader's shoulder, the leader in lingerie with her red scarf, a tender close moment.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 1 · 첫 번째 상자
missions.place: Harbor warehouse no. 3 at night, shipping containers, sodium lamps, sea fog. Snow falling, Christmas lights.
missions.beat: Christmas Eve. The enemy courier called Santa makes five stops tonight. First stop: a harbor warehouse where the 'gift box' is a bound hostage. She brings him out without killing anyone.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 2 · 끊긴 캐럴
missions.place: A mountain communications base at night, radio mast, pine forest, cold mist. Snow falling, Christmas lights.
missions.beat: A mountain relay station is hiding delivery signals inside a Christmas carol broadcast. Cut the transmitter and Santa goes blind.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 3 · 야근
missions.place: A corporate front office at night, glass walls, a cold blue server room. Snow falling, Christmas lights.
missions.beat: One office floor still lit on Christmas Eve. The server holds tonight's delivery list. Copy it unseen.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 4 · 폭죽
missions.place: An abandoned mine, timber-braced tunnels, dust in lamp light. Snow falling, Christmas lights.
missions.beat: Crates waiting to be gift-wrapped are stacked in a mine depot. Blow all of them: tonight's fireworks are ours.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 5 · 마지막 집
missions.place: A patron's mansion at night, chandeliers, a study with a hidden safe. Snow falling, Christmas lights.
missions.beat: The last house: a mansion Christmas party. Santa's ledger is in the safe, and the head of security is standing guard.

story.name: 스토리
story.mood: Tone: tense cinematic stealth thriller. Hard rim light, deep shadows, cold night palette with one warm accent.
tiers: Mission accomplished. A calm, confident moment right after the objective is done. Full mission outfit.
The most intense combat moment of this mission, dynamic action pose, motion and impact. Full mission outfit.
After the mission. A teasing, provocative pose aimed straight at the viewer, mission outfit loosened and partly unzipped, playful confident expression.
A private moment after the mission. The most sensual image of the set: lingerie-level or swimsuit-level outfit themed to this mission, intimate mood, implied closeness only.

seasonal.name: 시즈널
seasonal.mood: Tone: Christmas Eve. Falling snow, breath in cold air, red and gold holiday lights against deep blue night, fur trim and winter gear on the mission outfits.
tiers: Mission accomplished in the snow. A confident moment right after the objective is done, winter mission outfit, holiday lights behind.
The most intense combat moment of this stage, dynamic action in falling snow, motion and impact.
After the stage. A teasing, provocative pose at the viewer, winter jacket open off the shoulders, playful holiday mood (ribbon, mistletoe, a stolen Santa hat).

A private Christmas night after the mission by a fireplace or a tree. Lingerie-level festive outfit in red and white with fur trim, ribbons, warm firelight. The most sensual image of the set, implied closeness only.

costume.name: 코스튬
costume.mood: Tone: the costume is the star. Glossy, stylish, stage-like lighting, strong color accent in the agent's own color, glamorous and playful.
tiers: Mission accomplished in costume. A proud showpiece pose that shows the whole outfit clearly.
Fighting in the costume: a dynamic action moment that shows how the outfit moves.
Backstage after the mission. A teasing pose at the viewer, costume loosened, one piece half undone.
The most daring version of the same costume, lingerie-level, in a dressing room or boudoir, sensual and confident, implied only.

nights.mood: Tone: romance first. The viewer is the handler she trusts, and every cut is seen through his eyes; he is never shown (at most the edge of a hand or shoulder). Soft practical light only (a lamp, a candle, a rain-streaked window, first light of dawn), warm skin tones against cool shadows, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, close and quiet framing. Feeling comes from small things: a held gaze, an unplanned half smile, fingers reaching toward the camera, hair tucked behind an ear. Unguarded rather than posed. Everything physical is implied, never shown.
cuts: ARRIVAL. She comes in through the door still in her mission gear, tired, and finds the viewer waiting. Relief crosses her face.
UNWINDING. She puts the night down piece by piece: gear off, {sig}
QUIET TALK. Sitting close with a drink, knees almost touching, she tells what happened tonight. {talk}
CLOSING THE DISTANCE. She leans in toward the camera, one hand reaching for the viewer, outer layer gone, a camisole or loose shirt, a look that asks a question.
THE NIGHT. Lamp-lit bed or sofa, lingerie-level sleepwear or an oversized shirt, sheets and shadow doing the covering. She lies close, eyes on the viewer. Tender, slow, implied intimacy only.
MORNING AFTER. First light through the window, she is wrapped in a sheet or the viewer's shirt, hair loose, a soft unguarded smile. {morn} Match the mood of the ending reference image.

raven.place: A small safehouse room above the harbor, rain on the window, one warm lamp.
raven.sig: she finally unties the red scarf she has worn for three years and holds it out toward the viewer.
raven.talk: She has just learned that her teammate chose to stay behind; the guilt she carried is loosening.
raven.morn: The red scarf lies folded on the bedside table; she is not wearing it.

viper.place: A mountain lodge with a wide window, snow outside, a fireplace.
viper.sig: the rifle set against the wall, one unspent round placed upright on the table, her hair let down.
viper.talk: She did not fire, and for once that was the right call; she is learning to breathe without a scope.
viper.morn: The single round still stands on the table in the dawn light.

glitch.place: Her apartment full of monitors, neon from the street below.
glitch.sig: she switches off every screen one by one until only a lamp is left, then takes off her glasses and headphones.
glitch.talk: She burned the last copy of her real name tonight; only six people know her now, and she is about to tell a seventh.
glitch.morn: All the screens are dark; morning light is the only glow.

brick.place: A loft above a boxing gym, a heavy bag in the corner, brick walls.
brick.sig: she closes the door quietly for once, sets four dog tags on the table and lets the viewer unwrap the tape from her hands.
brick.talk: She found her people; she does not have to break anything tonight.
brick.morn: The dog tags hang by the window catching the light.

mirage.place: A hotel suite with a mirrored vanity, city lights beyond the curtains.
mirage.sig: at the mirror she takes off the earrings, the gloves and the makeup until it is her own bare face looking back.
mirage.talk: Tonight she walked away without acting; she wants to be seen without a role.

doc.place: The back room of a small clinic turned into a home, plants on the sill, a desk lamp.
doc.sig: she hangs up the white coat, washes her hands and, for once, lets the viewer bandage her scraped knuckles.
doc.talk: After ten years she wrote 'discharged' on the chart; the one she could not save walked out on his own feet.
doc.morn: The closed chart rests on the desk beside two coffee cups.
